newsitem.title: FRANCE: Arafat holds talks with Algeria's president.
newsitem.headline: Arafat holds talks with Algeria's president.

text.p: Palestinian President Yasser Arafat on Wednesday held talks with Algeria's President Liamine Zeroual on the floundering peace process between the Palestinian Authority and the Israeli government.

"I briefed President Zeroual on the serious developements of the peace process as a result of the Israeli government's stubbornness of not implementing what we agreed upon," Arafat was quoted as saying by Algerian state-run radio.

Arafat, on a brief visit to the North African country, was earlier greeted by Foreign Minister Ahmed Attaf and Abdelkader Bensalah, speaker of the government-appointed Transitional National Council, a quasi-parliament.
Israel and the PLO are currently negotiating the implementation of an Israeli troop redeployment, delayed since March, from parts of the West Bank town of Hebron.
The negotiations resumed after a White House summit called in response to Israeli-Palestinian violence erupted in September.
